arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Bristol-Myers Squibb argues California lacks jurisdiction over out-of-state patients.
California argues the company's local ties justify hearing these claims.
Justice Sotomayor questioned the due process implications of pendent jurisdiction.
Justice Ginsburg asked if manufacturing location creates nationwide jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the geographic limits of state court power over national companies. It determines whether one state can adjudicate injuries occurring elsewhere. The outcome shapes the balance between local judicial efficiency and corporate due process rights.
